subject: COVID-19 Community Support and Medical Surge Preparation
overview: The Solidarity Live program reviewed the impacts of COVID-19 on vulnerable populations and the medical system's preparation for a projected case surge. Discussions focused on housing stability for tenants, resources for the homeless, and the expansion of hospital capacity.

items.title: SNAP Online Delivery Petition
items.summary: Anna Callahan introduced the program and requested signatures for a petition to allow SNAP food assistance benefits to be used for online grocery delivery during the pandemic.

items.title: Somerville Homeless Coalition Impact Report
items.summary: Hannah O'Halloran discussed the challenges of social distancing in shelters, the loss of panhandling income for people in encampments, and the transition of shelters to 24/7 operations.

items.title: Affordable Housing and Tenant Relief
items.summary: David Tissell outlined the Somerville Community Corporation’s efforts to prevent displacement through the 100 Homes program and guided residents toward rental assistance resources like RAFT and the Cosecha fund.

items.title: Medical System Response and Surge Planning
items.summary: Dr. Myfanwy Callahan detailed the expansion of ICU beds in Massachusetts, the use of decontaminated N95 masks, and the establishment of a field hospital at the Boston Convention Center to handle the projected surge.
